summary: More operations of the user's e-bike battery model (a52.solidcraft, v2) on solidcore, beyond a52-battery-shapes and a52-wire-harness, chosen for coplanar, coaxial, coincident-cylinder and tangent contact between the booleans' operands. Dimensions are the model's own parameters: insert_dia 4, insert_depth 7, insert_mouth 0.35 and a 90 degree countersink on a boss_dia 8 stud (the inserty hole); access_dia 20, socket_dia 21.6, socket_depth 3.6, lip 1.6, pitch 22.7 (the gniazda counterbore holes of the cell holder plate); strip 0.15 (the nickel strips); peg_dia 3.8 and peg_reach 1.5 (the tray pegs); seat_r tube_od / 2 + foam_t = 25 (the cell tube seat); panel 3 with rib_depth 0.8 and rib_angle 60 deg (the panel ribs); grommet_bore 8.4, grommet_panel 3.3, grommet_flange 13 and wire_dia 5.5 (the grommet in its bore). Stand-ins, not in the model: the plate outline (69.4 x 46.7), the tray (100 x 60 x tray_floor 6), the seat block (100 x 60 x 26), the panel patch (20 x 60), the 6 wide strip, the 60 x 40 wall. The model's chamfers (rim_chamfer, plate_chamfer, bumper_chamfer, ...) and fillets have no step; a52-battery-shapes' fillet case stands for them. Every expected volume is a closed form written in its formula.

cases.name: insert_countersink_hole
cases.note: inserty: a blind hole coaxial with a boss, its 90 degree countersink mouth cut by a revolved tool that overshoots the top face

volume.formula: pi * 4^2 * 8 - pi * 2^2 * 6.65 - pi * 0.35 / 3 * (2^2 + 2 * 2.35 + 2.35^2) (the bore r 2 from z 1 to 7.65, then the cone frustum 0.35 long from r 2 to r 2.35 = (insert_dia + 2 * insert_mouth) / 2 at the top, z 8; the tool's axis is the boss's)

cases.name: socket_counterbore_grid
cases.note: gniazda: a 3 x 2 grid of counterbored holes, a r 10 through hole then a r 10.8 counterbore 3.6 deep, coaxial, on the 22.7 pitch

volume.formula: 69.4 * 46.7 * 5.2 - 6 * pi * (10^2 * 5.2 + (10.8^2 - 10^2) * 3.6) (each hole is the r 10 bore through the 5.2 plate plus the ring 10..10.8 over the top 3.6, z 1.6 to 5.2; the counterbore tool shares the through hole's axis)

cases.name: strip_bridging_holes
cases.note: nickel strip: a 0.15 thick strip laid flush on the plate top (and its side faces) across the through holes of the first row

volume.formula: 69.4 * 46.7 * 5.2 - 6 * pi * 10^2 * 5.2 + 69.4 * 6 * 0.15 (the strip stands on the top face z 5.2, so it adds its whole volume; it shares only area with the plate, over the ring between the holes, and spans the three holes of the y = 0 row, each r 10 wider than the strip)

cases.name: tray_pegs_tangent
cases.note: leze-czopy: four r 1.9 pegs standing on the tray top, one with its base circle tangent to the tray's left edge

volume.formula: 100 * 60 * 6 + 4 * pi * 1.9^2 * 1.5 (pegs at x 1.9, 31.9 and y 30, 40: each base disc lies on the top face z 6; the x = 1.9 ones are tangent to the edge x = 0 at a point)

cases.name: cell_seat_half_cylinder
cases.note: the cell tube seat: a r 25 = tube_od / 2 + foam_t cylinder along X cut from a block, its axis in the block's top plane, leaving a 1 mm floor

volume.formula: 100 * 60 * 26 - 100 * pi * 25^2 / 2 (the cylinder's axis lies in the top face z 26, so exactly half of it is inside the block; it spans the block's length with 10 to spare at each end, and stays 1 mm clear of the bottom z 0 and 5 of each side)

cases.name: panel_rib_sawtooth
cases.note: panel-ryfle: eight 60 degree V grooves, 0.8 deep, side by side so that their mouths meet in knife-edge ridges in the panel's top face

volume.formula: 20 * 60 * 3 - 8 * 60 * 0.8^2 * tan(30 deg) (a groove cross-section is the triangle with apex at z 2.2 and half width 0.8 * tan(30 deg) at the top face z 3, so each groove takes 0.5 * (1.6 * tan(30 deg)) * 0.8 * 60; the pitch 1.6 * tan(30 deg) = 0.92376 is that width, so the grooves touch along lines in z = 3; the tool triangles overlap above the face, not in the panel)

cases.name: grommet_in_bore
cases.note: grommet in its wall: a revolved stepped ring whose neck is the bore's cylinder (coincident surfaces) and whose flange sits on the wall top (coplanar annulus)

volume.formula: 60 * 40 * 3.3 - pi * 2.75^2 * 3.3 + pi * (6.5^2 - 2.75^2) * 2 (the neck r 2.75..4.2, z 0 to 3.3, fills the r 4.2 bore exactly, leaving the wire hole r 2.75 = wire_dia / 2 through the wall; the flange r 2.75..6.5, 2 thick, stands on the wall top z 3.3 and adds its whole volume)
